tooling_steps.instruction: Orchestrator shell step, no model (unit U03): in one Bash call, write-provenance.mjs --before --run-id=20261101-093743-feature-new-home-notifications-card --packet-id=tooling_U03 for `yarn.lock` and every other file the step writes, then `yarn install --no-immutable`, then write-provenance.mjs --after --run-id=20261101-093743-feature-new-home-notifications-card for each of them, whether the step succeeded or not (brownfield-runs.md, Phase 5). Install so yarn.lock records the additions of U01 and U02; the lockfile gains entries only, and nothing is removed or downgraded.

Orchestrator shell step, no model (unit U22): in one Bash call, write-provenance.mjs --before --run-id=20261101-093743-feature-new-home-notifications-card --packet-id=tooling_U22 for `plugins/notifications/report.api.md` and every other file the step writes, then `yarn build:api-reports plugins/notifications plugins/home-react`, then write-provenance.mjs --after --run-id=20261101-093743-feature-new-home-notifications-card for each of them, whether the step succeeded or not (brownfield-runs.md, Phase 5). Regenerate the API reports after the code they report on, as a step separate from the project checks. Besides this file it writes plugins/notifications/report-alpha.api.md, and plugins/home-react/report.api.md and report-alpha.api.md if they change; review shows plugins/home-react has no public API change, so those two are expected to stay as they are.
